purpose: A deterministic, deployment-visible test of whether the local motion signal found in v117 can transport the previous q8-minus-BP correction into the current warm initializer.
supersedes: v118 BP-difference control, which is a null direction under perfect observed translation
v119.0, which misstated the frozen v111 roster as 10 frames without its three-seed reporting axis
scope: already-open v111 five-trajectory PoolFire roster; known geometry; noiseless straight-ray proxy; no external, wall, RSS, or real-BOST claim
deployment_visible_inputs: previous q8 initial field when the current frozen frame index is greater than zero
previous cheap factor BP when the current frozen frame index is greater than zero
known geometry and fixed held-out coordinate map
temporal_rule: for frame zero use q8_current unchanged; for every other frozen frame t use arrays at t-1 and t, including non-frozen t-1 values
local_estimator: windowed FFT phase correlation, fixed eight nonoverlapping blocks
signal_acceptance: nonzero integer shift AND local coherence improvement > 1e-12

candidate.name: local-transport-q8-residual-K1
candidate.formula: q8_current + blockwise_zero_fill_shift(q8_previous - previous_BP, v117_shift) on accepted blocks only
candidate.fallback: q8_current when no fixed block accepts a signal or at frame zero
candidate.postprocess: the unchanged observation-only nonnegative line search and CGLS K1 shell

evaluation.roster: 5 trajectories x 3 geometries x 6 maps x 3 frozen reporting seeds x 11 frozen frames = 2970 cells
evaluation.deterministic_seed_rule: the deterministic candidate is run separately and identically for each frozen seed so that all-seed gates remain exactly comparable; seed is a reporting axis, not a training or selection axis
evaluation.gates: the frozen v111 eight matched-accuracy gates, per trajectory and geometry tails/harm
evaluation.failure_action: If any candidate compatibility, tail/harm, ledger, or independent-recomputation predicate fails, close the local residual-transport mechanism and do not train a neural model.

claim_boundary: A pass would be development proxy headroom only. It would not establish a learned advantage, wall/RSS benefit, external generalization, curved-ray validity, or real BOST performance.
